text:
Maria Chen: Hey team — noticed a customer report where they got double-charged for tokens after their SSE stream reconnected to a different region. root trace 0x7f3a. Repro steps attached.
Samir Patel: Ugh. Do we have a trace and the resume token the client sent?
Maria Chen: Pasting the truncated server-side log: 
```
INFO resume_attempt trace=0x7f3a client=webapp-42 from_region=eu-west -> routed_to=us-central
DEBUG resume_token=hdr(x-resume-id)=rsm_abc123 matched_session=false
INFO stream_replay start_seq=0 end_seq=24 tokens_replayed=24
METRIC sse.duplicate_events +1
```
The client had a resume token but our router sent it to a different region pool. Looks like we replayed the prefix and the client already had those tokens locally.
Jia Li: That suggests our routing policy's fallback to cheaper regions is breaking session affinity. We added that for cost savings during high load.
Ben Ortiz: Can you share the reproduction curl? I want to try locally.
Maria Chen: curl to reproduce: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -H "x-resume-id: rsm_abc123" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/stream
```
If the request hits a different zone than the original session, server currently treats resume token as opaque and replays.
Samir Patel: Two quick mitigation ideas: 1) Make resume tokens region-scoped so we reject/resignal clients to reattach rather than replay. 2) Implement a short idempotency window on the server where replayed token sequences are deduped if the same client id shows up within Xs.
Anya K: For UX/console, we should also expose a rollout toggle: "Preserve session affinity when enabling cost-fallbacks". PMs will want to turn cost fallbacks on without surprise billing.
infra-bot: Incident flagged: INC-3981 created for "SSE cross-region resume replay causing duplicate billing". Pager stubbed to #eng-oncall.
Jia Li: Telemetry to add: emit resume.bind_region and resume.routed_region and a boolean resume.region_mismatch. Dashboards: add a small panel to the streaming SLO board that graphs resume.region_mismatch -> spike correlates with duplicate_events.
Ben Ortiz: If we change tokens to be region-bound, we need a migration path for existing tokens. Maybe treat unbound tokens as legacy and fall through to the old logic for a short deprecation window.
Samir Patel: Implementation sketch: 
```
# pseudo
if token.region != current_region:
  respond: 409 TRY_RESUME_IN_REGION with header x-resume-region: token.region
  // client should reconnect to that region or we will not replay
else:
  resume normally
```
Also emit metric sse.resume_rejects_by_region.
Anya K: For rollout, propose a canary: enable region-bound tokens for 5% of traffic and route those clients to a small pool. Console should surface the canary toggle and expected billing impact.
Maria Chen: I filed a quick PR branch: fix/sse-region-affinity-1903 with code to attach region metadata to resume tokens and a server-side dedupe cache keyed by (client_id, resume_id, sequence). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7321 (draft).
ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled: tomorrow 0300 UTC — will put canary at 5% then.
Ben Ortiz: One open question: do we have client SDKs that will automatically follow TRY_RESUME_IN_REGION (redirect header)? mobile SDKs might need a library change.
Samir Patel: We'll add support in JS + Python SDKs to honor 409+ x-resume-region by reconnecting the socket to the specified region and preserving local cache. Add tests in the SDK repo.
Jia Li: Also add a telemetry probe that counts how many clients get the 409 and how many follow the redirect vs fail — metric sse.resume_redirects_success vs sse.resume_redirects_fail.
Maria Chen: Cool. I'll update the PR with the 409 behavior and a migration flag to opt into region-bound tokens.
Ben Ortiz: Sounds good. If the rollout OOMs, fallback plan is to flip cost-fallback off and revert token change. Ops team ready for that.
Samir Patel: Nice diagnostic work Maria. Small follow-ups: add unit tests for dedupe window and an integration test that simulates cross-region routing mismatch.
Anya K: I'll add the console UI mock for canary toggle and expected billing delta.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — will track on INC-3981 and the PR. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Acknowledged. Post-mortem reminded: include a short note about routing policy tradeoffs and cost vs sticky sessions.
